dialog.field-properties.title: Field Properties
dialog.field-properties.note: printcraft tools/prepare/properties.rs: Tabs vary by field kind (prepare/draft.rs:236): General, Appearance and Position always; Options for most; Format, Validate and Calculate for text and drop-down fields; Actions always. Locked is a General-tab check box that greys the others. OK applies every change as one edit (core/folio/commands/form.mjs form.field.properties). Office-only Orientation, Visibility, Units, Check Box Style Layout and Custom scripts are not in printcraft and are not shown.

dialog.bulk-field-properties.note: printcraft tools/bulk_fields.rs: several fields selected open Shared Field Properties; only checked properties change (form.field.properties with `names`).

alltools.form.preview.note: Preview / Edit fields: try the form as people filling it in will see it.

calc.edit-formula.label: Edit formula
calc.edit-formula.note: Opens Field Properties on the Calculate tab of the field picked in the order.

calc.links.note: Links on page (calc_order_ui.rs:678) draws the reads between calculated fields on the page: not translated, so hidden.

alltools.form.text-field-table.note: Text field table (field_table_ui.rs) is not translated yet: hidden.

alltools.form.barcode.note: Hidden: printcraft has no barcode field (Acrobat Pro only).

alltools.form.distribute.note: Hidden: printcraft has no Distribute form / tracking service (Acrobat Pro only).

alltools.form.track.note: Hidden: printcraft has no form tracker (Acrobat Pro only).

alltools.form.highlight-fields.note: Upstream offers this only from the notice bar (canvas/bars.rs:210: Highlight fields / Hide field highlights); the tool panel toggle is the same command.
